upstream.name: mozilla/readability
upstream.architecture: JavaScript DOM scoring/extraction engine, readerable preflight, JSDOM parser shim, metadata extraction, content cleanup, and fixture-driven expected HTML/metadata parity.

benchmarkDenominator.source: Shallow sparse upstream checkout in .upstream-cache/readability at commit 08be6b4bdb204dd333c9b7a0cfbc0e730b257252; counted package.json test runner, test/test-*.js harnesses, and test/test-pages fixture directories. The Mozilla normalize-spaces, parsely-metadata, and mozilla-2 source.html, expected.html, and expected-metadata.json fixtures are now copied into the lane and mapped by native PHP tests.

runnerStatus.reason: The full upstream runner could not execute in the sparse cache because dependencies were not installed. Probe command `npm test` reached the package script `mocha test/test-*.js` and failed before running tests with `sh: line 1: mocha: command not found`. Installing upstream npm dependencies was deferred to keep this lane slice modest.

mappedSemantics: Readability-readerable default minContentLength 140 and minScore 20 scoring thresholds.
Readability-readerable custom minContentLength and minScore options.
Readerable rejection for hidden, aria-hidden, li p, and unlikely class/id candidates.
Readability unlikely candidate and role cleanup for migration/page-builder chrome.
Semantic article/main/section scoring preference over outer page containers.
WordPress block serialization for extracted headings and paragraphs.

Mozilla test-pages/normalize-spaces source/expected/metadata fixture: document-title precedence, readerable true classification, null byline/site/published/dir metadata, excerpt whitespace normalization, and extracted article text parity against expected.html.

Mozilla test-pages/parsely-metadata source/expected/metadata fixture: Parse.ly title, byline, and published-time metadata extraction, readerable true classification, excerpt normalization, null site/dir/lang metadata, and extracted article text parity against expected.html.

Mozilla test-pages/mozilla-2 source/expected/metadata fixture: OpenGraph site name and description metadata, document lang/dir extraction, readerable false classification, retained in-main header content markers, and exclusion of head comment text.
benchmarkDenominator.warning: This replaces the seed denominator with a cloned static inventory and now maps three Mozilla page fixtures locally, but it is still not upstream runner parity. Native PHP progress maps 10 local behavior tests and 36 local checks against a 1984-test upstream Mocha denominator.

nativeImplementation.currentSlice: Native DOM extractor removes chrome and unlikely candidates, preserves in-main headers, scores semantic content containers, implements Mozilla-style isProbablyReaderable thresholds, extracts document/Parse.ly/OpenGraph titles and descriptions, exposes byline/site/published/dir/lang metadata fields including Parse.ly author/date selectors, maps the Mozilla normalize-spaces, parsely-metadata, and mozilla-2 fixtures, and emits simple WordPress blocks.

wordpressScenario: Migration-aware article cleanup into clean WordPress blocks with page-builder navigation, comment widgets, share UI, surrounding theme chrome, and copied Mozilla fixture coverage for whitespace-normalized extraction, Parse.ly metadata, and OpenGraph site/lang/dir metadata.
nextTask: Map another Mozilla fixture with media handling or closer expected-HTML cleanup parity, then broaden metadata cleanup.
